name: @brianjenkins94/run-contract
description: What brianjenkins94/editor reads from a run, and asks of it — the custom debug events a debugger sends (values, coverage, effects, ended, ask, recorded, listening, idle) and the requests it answers (decide, stdin, getCoverage) — and the workspace runtime a debugger's worker connects to (./runtime), and span annotations — placing something on code so it stays on that code (./annotations). tsval's, and any interpreter plugged in as run.debugger.
